title: 責められるべきはトレーナー？

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To prepare for the Tenno Sho, Mejiro McQueen's training regimen has been anchored around the basics.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Onlookers and other trainers cast a critical eye over us. To them, the regimen doesn't seem practical for garnering success.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In turn, things become a bit strained between Mejiro McQueen and I.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This troubles her. However, she soon realizes she can trust me after speaking with Mejiro Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We renew our faith in each other and the promise we share, returning to the path we set for the Tenno Sho.
